## Why visit

One of the strongest reasons to take the train north for pub heritage. The Volly retains a remarkably intimate arrangement of bar, panelled passage, hatches and lounge, with Higsons glass connecting it to an earlier Liverpool brewing era. CAMRA also records the survival of table service when circumstances allow, making the experience more than a collection of old fittings. Combine it with Four Ashes for a relaxed, compact coastal excursion that contrasts a preserved traditional local with a modern beer-focused micropub.
